mainEntity.name: Is Hatekhori really 100% free with no hidden charges?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Hatekhori is an open typeface atelier. There are no paywalls, no tiered feature locks, and no subscriptions. You can generate and download complete OpenType fonts without providing a credit card or signing up.

mainEntity.name: Why does Calligraphr limit free fonts to 75 characters?

acceptedAnswer.text: Calligraphr limits its free tier to 75 glyphs as an incentive to convert users to their $8/month subscription. 75 characters is only enough for basic Latin uppercase and lowercase letters, excluding punctuation, numbers, and accents.

mainEntity.name: Can I use the fonts I create commercially?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Because the font is derived directly from your own physical handwriting, you own full commercial rights to the output font file (.otf/.ttf/.woff2) for use in websites, books, videos, and merchandise.

mainEntity.name: How does Hatekhori protect my handwriting photo privacy?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hatekhori strips all EXIF metadata (such as smartphone camera model and GPS coordinates) immediately upon ingest. Uploads are processed without mandatory user accounts, and raw photos are never publicly exhibited without consent.
